ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across approximately 70-75% of the visible fluke area, with high-intensity (white) patches restricted to the distal lobes.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distal left lobe contains a large white patch with a single high-contrast dark circular spot located centrally within the white field. Distal right lobe contains a large white patch interrupted by five distinct, vertically oriented dark linear bands (rake marks).

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees, extending into the fluke body at a depth of 12% of total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-amplitude serration. Left tip exhibits a jagged, fragmented contour with small missing segments. Right trailing edge features a prominent, deep concave indentation (missing piece) approximately midway between the notch and the tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex proximal sweep transitions to an irregular, multi-angled distal trajectory. The extreme tips of both lobes exhibit sharp upward-sloping points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Texture-rich, high-contrast brown and white pixel clusters (barnacles) concentrated on the extreme terminal edges and tips of both fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of four to five parallel, dark, high-contrast linear marks (rake marks) cutting across the white pigment field of the right distal lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant tissue loss/notch on the right trailing edge; jagged, irregular tip on the left lobe suggestive of prior physical trauma; extensive rake marks on the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Isolated circular dark pigmentation spot located in the center of the left lobe's distal white region.
